Spoiler • edit

Messages

World Board: Hail to the King! It's Kingsday in Thais, join the celebration!
Towncryer: Hear ye! Hear ye! It is Kingsday, people, let us celebrate and sing! Decorate Thais and let the bells ring! Come to the arena to hear the swords cling. Let us rejoice! Hail to the King!

Method

The day is dedicated to celebrating the King. This Mini World Change takes place in Thais, and the following changes take place:

  • Thais will be decorated for the day (as it was for Tibia's 15th Anniversary).
  • Thaian NPCs will talk differently during the day.
  • If it's Sunday, you can enter the Tibian Prize Exhibition for free.
  • Raids will occur in the Knights' Guild arena (32395, 32193, 7) every hour (approximately 2-20 minutes after the hour) in 2 waves. The second wave is triggered 2 minutes after the first one. Raid creatures will despawn 30 minutes after spawning if they are not killed.
  • Cursing at King Tibianus will have you sent to the Thaian Jail, where you will remain until the next raid in the Knights' Guild arena. You cannot logout in the jail, there is no way to leave before the next raid.
  • Greeting the king will reward players with the achievement Loyal Subject.

Raids

It is possible to loot Party Lampions, Party Wall Tinsels and Party Wall Snakes from raiding creatures.

  • The King's mages have summoned some creatures from the tombs in the knight's arena for your enjoyment. — Larvae, Scarabs, Ghouls, Mummys, Crypt Shamblers, Gargoyles.
  • The King's mages have summoned some goblins in the knight's arena for your enjoyment. — Goblins, Goblin Scavengers, Goblin Assassins, Goblin Leaders.
  • The King's mages have summoned some creatures from the Tiquanda jungle in the knight's arena for your enjoyment. — Terramites, Wasps, Centipedes, Carniphilas, Slimes.
  • The King's mages have summoned some dragons in the knight's arena for your enjoyment. — Dragons, Dragon Hatchlings.
  • The King's mages have summoned some dragon lords in the knight's arena for your enjoyment. — Dragon Lords, Dragon Lord Hatchlings.
  • The King's mages have summoned some frost dragons in the knight's arena for your enjoyment. — Frost Dragons, Frost Dragon Hatchlings.
  • The King's mages have summoned some lizards in the knight's arena for your enjoyment. — Low Class Lizards (Lizard Sentinels, Lizard Snakecharmers and Lizard Templars) and Wyverns.
  • The King's mages have summoned some minotaurs in the knight's arena for your enjoyment. — Minotaurs, Minotaur Archers, Minotaur Mages, Minotaur Guards.
  • The King's mages have summoned some trolls in the knight's arena for your enjoyment. — Frost Trolls, Swamp Trolls, Troll Champions, Troll Legionnaires, Troll Guards, Furious Trolls, Mechanical Fighters.
  • The King's mages have summoned some orcs in the knight's arena for your enjoyment. — Orcs, Orc Spearman, Orc Shamans, Orc Warriors, Orc Riders, Orc Berserkers and Orc Leaders.
  • The King's mages have summoned some elementals in the knight's arena for your enjoyment. — Earth Elementals, Energy Elementals, Fire Elementals, Water Elementals.
  • The King's mages have summoned some dworcs in the knight's arena for your enjoyment. — Dworc Venomsnipers, Dworc Fleshhunters and Dworc Voodoomasters.
